definition: Production release blocked until every required gate is verified with supporting independently reviewable evidence. Passing configuration validation never proves boot.

gates.description: OpenCore/macOS documentation reconciled to pinned versions
Read-only scanner and privacy tests
25+ exact hardware-aware documented architecture profiles with real compatibility evidence
Fail-closed full CPU/GPU/chipset/firmware/ACPI compatibility matching
Locally generated, unique and validated SMBIOS identity workflow
Hardware-specific EFI generator with validated kext ordering/SMBIOS/SSDT
Pinned official OpenCore 1.0.8 ocvalidate integration and CI schema checks
Independently verified supplier signatures, licenses, hashes and provenance
Official Apple-hosted online recovery/installer preparation
Complete offline installer preparation with filesystem/format verification
Compiled functional Windows Setup Assistant beginner/expert modes
Safe confirmed physical-device USB creation and restoration tests
Real usable architecture-specific EFI ZIP release
Real partition IMG, readback and checksum tests
Real whole-disk IMG, GPT/ESP validation and readback tests
Bootable portable Linux recovery/live environment
Non-destructive EFI migration, backup, restore and rollback
Windows/Linux/macOS bootloader preservation and multiboot acceptance
Verified legacy Apple Mac/OpenCore Legacy Patcher compatibility track
Documented isolated experimental compatibility and risk handling
Kernel panic and boot log classifications with verified remediation guidance
Physical UEFI boot and usable macOS documented on named compatible hardware
Threat model, redaction, disk rollback and signed release artifacts
Complete cross-linked README, sources, exact supported/unsupported hardware
Cross-platform source test suite, Windows toolkit compilation and automatic alpha packaging
Actual final non-alpha production GitHub Release with all required assets and valid signatures
